response.sql: SELECT s.zoneref AS zoneref, si.riskeval AS riskeval, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.riskeval ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
